text:
sam: heads-up — seeing intermittent throughput drop (~8%) in us-west2 GPU pool for the last hour. Alerts pointing to repeated PCIe resets on rack-17 nodes. dmesg shows AER and nvlink entries, posting snippets below.

ida: can you paste the exact logs and which nodes are hit? any Xid codes in the GPU driver metrics?

sam: logs pasted: `[ 12345.678901] pcieport 0000:3a:00.0: AER: Corrected error received: severity=Corrected, type=Physical Layer`
`[ 12345.679000] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: nvlink: link 1 down, status 0x40`
`[ 12345.679100] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 13`
Affected nodes: ip-10-0-17-12, ip-10-0-17-14, ip-10-0-17-20 (rack-17 rows 3-5).

oncall-bot: Incident detected: pci-errors-high in us-west2-gpu. 12 nodes flagged. Pager duty: sam, ida. :rotating_light:

maria: sounds like repeated root-port/slot resets rather than a single card panic. recommend cordon+drain the most affected nodes (start with ip-10-0-17-12). Any jobs pinned to specific GPUs?

sam: a few long-running customers are pinned. I'll notify them. Quick checks commands I ran: `kubectl get pods -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=ip-10-0-17-12` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,utilization.gpu,retired_pages --format=csv`.

ida: running those now — ECC corrected counts rising on GPU-7 and GPU-9 on ip-10-0-17-12. retired_page_count non-zero on GPU-9. This looks like progressive memory errors + NVLink recoveries. Recommend immediate cordon.

maria: I'm drafting a short drain runbook for this event: 1) `kubectl cordon <node>` 2) `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` 3) tag node in console as `maintenance:pcie` 4) collect logs (`dmesg | grep -i aer`, `journalctl -k -u kubelet`) 5) schedule onsite swap/RMA. Attaching ticket INF-3241. :white_check_mark:

sam: also let's route new scheduling away from rack-17 for the next 2 hours and increase autoscaler headroom to absorb migrations. ops-team, please post a brief customer notice for affected jobs.

ida: no objections. grabbing `lspci -vvv` and `nvlink status` now. nvlink output: `nvlink0: lane errors=consistent, recoveries=13, last_recovery=12345s`. I'll upload to the ticket.

maria: thanks — I'll open RMA for the two suspected cards and request the rack tech for a physical reseat and BIOS slot diagnostics. Proposed maintenance window: tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC.

sam: plan acknowledged. I'll run the drain on ip-10-0-17-12 and report back in this thread when complete. :thumbsup:

ops-team: posted customer note and increased scheduler headroom. tagging infra-oncall for visibility.

sam: update — drain complete for ip-10-0-17-12, pods rescheduled. Monitoring performance; will keep rack-17 cordoned until RMA completes. If we see repeat resets after reseat, we'll escalate to hardware vendor.
